text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm in your care, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Let's take it easy and not push too hard!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Right! Healing comes first… which means doing my best at rehab, right!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since she's in rehab, we can't start full-scale training yet.
However, that doesn't mean there's nothing we can do. In fact—

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, <username>! Looking a bit livelier, aren't we?
That's great, we were worried about you!

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer B
text_block_list.text: You were looking pretty down, so we were thinking of treating you to a meal—

text_block_list.name: Both Trainers
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Wh-What is it?!
choice_data_list: Actually, there's something I'd like to ask your advice on…!

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Looking to cover all your bases, huh… Alright, leave it to us! Experience is
important, but passing knowledge down as seniors is part of the job too!

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
One of the trainees I worked with suffered the exact same injury.
I still have the records from back then, so I'll make a copy for you later.

text_block_list.name: Both Trainers
text_block_list.text: Give it your all, rookie!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Advice from senior trainers, books from the library, past case records—
I pore over every resource available to craft her rehabilitation routine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even that won't be enough; I need to have a solid plan
for what comes after her recovery, too—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer, have you eaten lunch yet?
choice_data_list: Huh, is it that time already?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's actually a little past lunch time already.
So, um… I brought this for you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I made it hoping we could eat together.
I'm pretty confident in my sweet and sour meatballs! Ehehe.
choice_data_list: Thank you, this makes me really happy.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm glad! If there's anything else you'd like to eat,
just let me know! I'll keep it in mind for next time♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, the days of rehabilitation flew by in a flash,
and the day to resume training finally arrived!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It's finally time…!
I'm ready when you are, Trai—
Ayyy, let's gooo!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Pace-running, let's gooo! We're blasting a full-throttle sprint on this short track~!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Totally, big mood~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! Next up is the hill course? Bring it on! No matter the slope or wall,
I shall overcome it! For I am the class president, after all!!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (Everyone is so amazing…! But starting today, I'll be right there with—)
choice_data_list: Let's start with some light-load dirt track practice first.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh…?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
choice_data_list: Are you worried about this routine?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
…No! I believe in the training plan you made for me,
Trainer. So I won't get impatient anymore!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Once again, I'm in your hands!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so training began, with Nishino Flower
steadily regaining her original running form.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I continued studying to give her everything I had,
the day came—a mock race was held at the academy.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: A m-mock race… Uuu, I'm getting nervous…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (Back then, I couldn't keep up at all… It was so painful, but…)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Still, still… I worked hard alongside Trainer, so
surely my running will be—…?)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
…Trainer, you're shaking.
Are you nervous?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
…With my voice cracking like that, I carry zero credibility.
Yet no matter how nervous I might be, my faith in her is unshakable.
choice_data_list: The Flower you are right now can win this…!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ! Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: …*deep breath in*, *out*…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: —Yes! I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ※SE dummy text.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: “The Flower you are right now can win this…!”

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Your voice was trembling… but you said it with complete conviction.
That I could win. That the me right now can win.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(So, I will answer that call.
To the Trainer who believed in me, I'll send you my courage!)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(It's okay, everything will be fine. I want to encourage them...
I have to tell them with my running.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (Just like back then—when Mom and Dad smiled!)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (So I can give courage to so many people...!)

text_block_list.name: Commentator Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
...Goooaal!
In 1st place is Nishino Flower! It's Nishino Flower!!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! Thank you so much!!
I... From now on, I'm going to do even, even better...!
choice_data_list: As your Trainer, I'll give it my all too!!
As your Trainer, I'll give it my all too!!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...! Traineeeer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Amidst the cheers, Nishino Flower smiled. It was a smile
reminiscent of the blooming flowers we had once watched together.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(My Trainer is someone who always tries so hard.
Such a dedicated person, always pushing themselves past their limits.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(—That's why one day, I want to take 1st place in a GⅠ,
and gift you that victory.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(To my hardworking Trainer.
Thank you for always supporting me.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (And thank you for giving me courage.)
